network.account_inactive: Cloud account controls are available in Pomodorough Cloud mode.

network.leave_conflicted_accessible: Leave conflicted Iroh room and prepare rotation
network.privacy: PRIVACY NOTICE · Direct peers learn each other's IP addresses. Relay traffic is end-to-end encrypted, but relay operators can observe endpoint IDs, IP addresses, timing, and volume. Invite codes grant full room read/write access and can contain network addresses. Iroh v1 has no member revocation; rotate into a new room to remove a member.
network.iroh_saved_unavailable: Iroh mode is saved, but optional Iroh service or active room metadata is unavailable.

network.wait_cloud_open: Wait for the active Cloud request before opening an Iroh room.
network.wait_cloud_join: Wait for the active Cloud request before joining an Iroh room.
network.wait_join: Wait for Iroh room join to finish before changing local state.
network.invite_copied: Invite copied. Treat it as a full-access secret.
network.leave_detail: Leaving restores state from before room activation. Room log remains saved for later reactivation.

account.heading: ACCOUNT & PRIVACY
account.delete_prompt: This permanently deletes your Pomodorough Cloud account, timer, task, and history data and revokes every session. Local data is cleared only after the server confirms deletion. Type DELETE exactly to continue.
account.delete_mismatch: Account deletion was not confirmed. Type DELETE exactly.
account.delete_failed: Account deletion failed. Your account and local data were preserved: {error}
account.delete_succeeded: Account deleted. Account-bound local data was cleared.
account.switch_tooltip: Signed-in account differs from local data owner. Click to switch or sign out.
account.resolution_tooltip: Signed in; local and synced history must be resolved. Click to continue.
account.synced_tooltip: Signed in and synced. Click to sign out.
account.pending_tooltip: Signed in; sync pending. Click to sign out.
account.signout_detail: Signing out clears this account's timer, history, and tasks from this device. It will also discard {queue}.
account.resolve_question: Continue resolving history or sign out?
account.resolve_detail: Signing out clears this account's timer, history, tasks, and pending resolution from this device.
account.different_question: Signed-in account does not own this device's local data.
account.different_detail: Clear the previous account's local timer, history, tasks, and pending resolution to switch, or sign out without changing that data.
resolution.title: Choose synchronized state
resolution.question: This device and your account both contain synchronized data.
resolution.detail: This device and your account both contain synchronized timer, history, task, or settings data. Choose how to continue before making more changes.
resolution.confirm_local_detail: Account timer, history, tasks, settings, and queued changes will be replaced by this device's data.
resolution.confirm_remote_detail: This device's timer, history, tasks, settings, and queued changes will be replaced by account data.
resolution.confirm_both_detail: Queued local changes will be merged into account data. Conflicts or rejected changes are possible.
resolution.blocked: Resolve local and synced history before changing timers, tasks, or durations.
resolution.stale_response: Sync response did not match an active request.
resolution.discard_failed: Could not discard stale history resolution request.
resolution.changed: History changed before resolution could be applied.
resolution.refreshing: Refreshing synced history; local data is preserved.
tray.running_detail: Timer remains available in system tray.
iroh.first_room_guidance: Create or join a room before activating the Iroh route. The route will not be saved until a usable room exists.
terminal.history_resolution_pending: Account history resolution pending; timer changes are blocked.

tui.keys_secondary: 1 focus  2 short break  3 long break  +/- duration  q quit

error.duration_range: Duration must be between 1 and 180 minutes.
